calculator.existing_page: /calculator computes a user-assumption 'hypothetical' repeated-chance model (lib/advanced-research possessionFlow); it holds no observed data and does not implement the paper's Eq. (11).
calculator.new_data_needed: League (and team) season inputs for Eq. (11): eFG%, FTr, FG%, FT%, TOV% (Eq. 10), ORB% (Eq. 9), the season's mu (share of possession-ending free throws, paper Appendix A), plus offensive-rebound rates after missed twos, threes and final free throws for Databallr's split rebound term.

paper_verified_from_primary_source.authors: Jirka Poropudas (SportIQ, Helsinki) and Topi Halme (Aalto University)
paper_verified_from_primary_source.eq10: TOV% = TOV / (FGA + TOV - ORB + mu FTA)
paper_verified_from_primary_source.eq11: ORTG = (1 - TOV%)(FTr + 2 eFG%) / (1 - ORB%(1 - FG%) + mu FTr / FT%)
paper_verified_from_primary_source.league_2024_25: alpha 0.131 (ORB on missed FT), beta 0.795 (make rate of possession-ending FT), epsilon 0.026 (Appendix B, Remark 2 discussion)
paper_verified_from_primary_source.mu: Kubatko et al. 0.44 (2003-06); paper 0.425 for 2024-25 (Appendix A)
paper_verified_from_primary_source.title_v1: Dean Oliver's Four Factors Revisited (the arXiv listing and search results for v1)
paper_verified_from_primary_source.title_v2: Decomposing Basketball Team Efficiency Using the Four Factors and Shapley Values

content_reference.calculator: Owner's saved Databallr page 'Offensive Rating Calculator' (ORTG Lab): ORTG = 100 x xSHOT x xEFF x xPOSS with xSHOT = 1 - TOV%, xEFF = 2 eFG% + FTr x FT%, xPOSS a recycle multiplier from 2P, 3P and FT offensive rebounds; league-average defaults and a marginal value per +1% for eFG, 2P, 3P, FT, TS, 3PA rate, FT rate, TOV, FG/2P/3P/FT OREB; credits Poropudas and Halme, 'Dean Oliver's Four Factors Revisited'; FT possession-ending weight 0.43.
content_reference.shot_aftermath: Owner's saved Databallr page 'Shot Aftermath': seasons 2024-25 and 2025-26, filters by shooting team and shooter position (guards/forwards/bigs), first-chance attempts by zone (rim, short mid 5-14 ft, long mid 15+ ft, three) with FG%, made points, second-chance points and opponent cost per attempt, opponent PPP after makes and misses.
content_reference.wingspan: Owner's saved Databallr page 'Wingspan Database - NBA Height & Wingspan Resource' (2026-11-06). Shows: Active/Inactive and position filters, barefoot/with-shoes (+1.25 in) height, inches or ft-in, CSV with nba_id; table of position, height, wingspan, diff (W-H) and D-DPM, each with a percentile; Avg H/W/Diff; positional averages (PG..C height, wingspan, diff); a selected-player overlay; a 'find similar profiles' action per row; a scatter with two selectable axes among height, wingspan, diff, D-DPM and its R; sources 'NBA Combine, Nick Kalinowski, NBA.com, CraftedNBA'.

note: Coverage counts only. No correlation, positional average, nearest build, mu or rating was computed before the registrations.

shot_aftermath.finding: Not restyle only. Databallr's page is a league/team/position view by shot zone for two seasons. CourtLens's /research/shooting/aftermath is per player and reads workbench_pbp_events, workbench_possessions and workbench_shots, which in the published database hold 2 test games (dataset 17251a08...). Serving Databallr's content needs new data (a frozen aggregate from the play-by-play archives). Left out of R10 and raised with the owner.

temporal: DARKO's dated season-end boards are retrospective: each is DARKO's pregame forecast at the season's last regular-season game date, recomputed later with DARKO's current model (R08 left DARKO out of its backtest as hindsight for this reason). Wingspan against D-DPM is a descriptive association between a pre-draft measurement and a later rating, not a forecast and not a causal claim.

darko_board_season_without_logged_minute.reason: DARKO lists the player on its season-end board but the published game logs have no regular-season minutes for him that season (did not play, or rated from earlier seasons); never counted as 0 minutes.

logged_minutes_without_darko_rating.reason: Minutes in the game logs but no row on DARKO's season-end regular-season board: D-DPM unknown for that season, never zero.

wingspan.id_matching: Combine rows carry the NBA person ID; game logs and DARKO boards key by the same NBA person ID. No name matching. Rows without an ID are excluded, never name-matched.
